integrity: The theorem is based on an analytical Fourier and binomial-limit argument, supported by reproducible finite checks that do not certify asymptotics or novelty.
scientific_limitations: The leading constant sqrt(2pi) is an upper obstruction constant from the fourth Walsh mode, not a claimed asymptotic equivalent for global supremal negative type. The theorem does not classify finite-dimensional critical exponents; other Fourier modes may yield stronger bounds. Historical originality remains qualified; independent review has not been performed.
title: Exponential collapse of negative type under antipodal folding of Hamming cubes
